Concluded the opt-in user path works end to end on Linux; Windows runs standalone, as declared.

All six member specs of the four milestones are status done (verified in .pose/specs). The milestones' review records are not in this checkout, by the implementer's note; reviewed closeout is confirmed by closeout-check, which is deferred to after the attestation.

findings.action: The resident Git memo key digests only .git/config and shallow, not global/user/system or included Git config, which RawHistoryGit does not neutralise; after a config change during the runtime's life a hosted check can print output that differs from standalone. This contradicts resident_git_memo.go:19 and ADR line 294, weakens the B35 deterministic-output and B33 no-stale-cache gates, and is absent from the roadmap's not-delivered list (roadmap lines 11-14); it is tracked only in draft spec pose-runtime-memo-hits-and-git-config-key.
Count memo hits per operation (draft spec pose-runtime-memo-hits-and-git-config-key R1).
findings.rationale: memo_hits is the difference of a global counter read before and after the command (lines 134, 145), so with concurrent lanes it includes other commands' hits.
